name: Discovery and spider lane
summary: Find source surfaces, crawl approved pages, archive snapshots, hash content, and emit governed source records without publishing derived objects.
privacy_controls: raw snapshots stay in object storage

name: Repository and workflow mining lane
summary: Mine public repositories, package metadata, workflow exports, MCP servers, ComfyUI graphs, n8n flows, Flowise flows, Dify apps, and Langflow graphs into normalized workflow primitives.

name: Enrich, embed, and verify lane
summary: Convert governed snapshots into candidate objects, link entities, cluster duplicates, batch embeddings, assign labels and dimensions, and verify citations and policies.
privacy_controls: sensitive data gate before hosted model
tenant boundary retained on every row

name: Prompt cache standardization lane
summary: Normalize stable prompt prefixes, schema blocks, tool signatures, and rubric language so repeated harness calls can benefit from provider prefix caching and local trajectory-fragment reuse.
privacy_controls: do not store sensitive variable content in shared prefix cache

name: Promotion and warehouse lane
summary: Run evals, route review tickets, emit promotion decisions, update indexes, and export cold partitions to BigQuery or another analytic tier.
cost_controls: materialize hot slices back to Postgres
